description: Substitute named placeholders in a URL template with values drawn from a record. A template segment of the form ':name' is replaced by the record's attribute of that name; every occurrence of a given placeholder is replaced. When an optional auxiliary parameter map is supplied, any key that was consumed as a path placeholder is removed from that map (so it will not later be appended as a redundant query parameter), while unrelated keys are left untouched. The interpolated URL is reported, and when a parameter map is supplied its remaining contents are reported as well.
